reduce-to-circuit:
(program
  (kernel-declaration (%kernel.2 () (Kernel)))
  (public-ledger-declaration
    ((%seeds.1 (0) (Map (tunsigned 255) (tbytes 32)))))
  (witness %seed.3 () (tbytes 32))
  (circuit %reveal.0 ((%slot.4 (tunsigned 255))) (ttuple)
    (= #t %s.5 (call %seed.3))
    (= #t %t.6 (public-ledger %seeds.1 (0) insert %slot.4 %s.5))
    (= #t %t.7 (tuple)) %t.7))
